source.name: Minnesota United: 'Minnesota United Presents 2026 "Decade Kit"'
source.quote: Target returns as the primary kit partner and will continue to be featured on the front of the jersey as they have been since the club’s inaugural MLS season
source.note: The page's publication date (2026-02-10) is from its datePublished metadata; the page body shows no date line. FOR SOCCER's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor survey (Feb 17, 2026) lists Target as Minnesota United's front-of-jersey partner, agreeing.

source.name: Minnesota United: 'Minnesota United Presents 2026 "Decade Kit"'
source.quote: For a second consecutive season, Minnesota United’s jerseys will feature NutriSource Pet Foods and Finley’s Pet Treats as the club’s exclusive sleeve sponsors.
source.note: One joint patch on the right sleeve carries both brands; FOR SOCCER's 2026 survey lists the right sleeve as 'NutriSource / Finley's', agreeing.

source.name: FOR SOCCER: '2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors'
source.quote: media partner Apple, once again, will be on the left sleeve of every jersey
source.note: League-wide Apple TV patch on the left sleeve; the survey's per-club table lists 'Apple TV' on Minnesota United's left sleeve. The league deal is recorded in data/deals/mls-apple-tv.json (clubId null).

summary: The 'Decade Kit', Minnesota United's 2026 primary jersey marking ten MLS seasons: Target on the front as it has been since the club's 2017 MLS debut, NutriSource Pet Foods and Finley's Pet Treats together on the right sleeve for a second season, and the league-wide Apple TV patch on the left sleeve of every MLS kit. No back-of-jersey or shorts sponsor exists: the club's kit launch names no others, and MLS only opens back-of-jersey ad space after the 2026 All-Star Break (SportsLogos.Net, Mar 2, 2026).
